title: A named exudyn.symbolic.Matrix is never freed
author: Claude-JG
description: revision2026c step RG12.49.5 (found in RG12.49.2): esym.Matrix('M', [[1., 2.], [3., 4.]]) leaves one matrix node when it is deleted (esym.Matrix.__newCount - __deleteCount grows by 1); MatrixExpressionReal increments its reference counter in its constructor, and the holder once more. A named vector and a named Real are freed.
releaseNotes: A named exudyn.symbolic.Matrix is freed with its last reference; its constructor from an array counted the node twice in Matrix.__newCount, which looked like a node left over. symbolicOptimizeTest.py counts the named matrix.
